# Isaiah Chapter 14 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 32 verses]*

*Taunt song; fallen tyrant; descent to Sheol; Day Star/Lucifer imagery; Philistia oracle*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 14 (Fall of the King of Babylon) addresses taunt song; fallen tyrant; descent to sheol; day star/lucifer imagery; philistia oracle. The key verse — "How you have fallen from heaven, O morning star, son of the dawn!" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
